Agent-supplied signing secrets, webhook secrets, private keys, client secrets, and project secrets return a saved human credential-entry handoff without changing credentials. Authorized write-only bot tokens and API keys remain supported. Credentials are stored as Automatic Organisation secret references and are never returned. Other actions do not require credentials.

post.summary: Resolve an unconfirmed chat publication

post.summary: Resolve an unconfirmed provider action
post.description: After checking the provider, an operator may mark an ambiguous durable provider reply delivered, retry it while accepting duplicate risk, or cancel it. Slack slash-command task starts support explicit retry or cancel only. Automatic Organisation never replays an ambiguous provider action automatically, and every resolution is audited.

post.summary: Publish a Automatic Organisation task comment to an external conversation
post.description: Explicitly projects an eligible comment from the bound Automatic Organisation task into the provider conversation. The endpoint, conversation, and comment must belong to the same binding. A Board send with an already-bound attachment returns 409 with code chat_board_send_attachments_already_bound and request-scoped details (endpointId, conversationId, idempotencyKey, attachmentIds). get.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Returns { ownerUserId, areas, responsibilities, proposed, totals, loose }: the company's active areas (plus any area a returned responsibility is under) with this person's active responsibilities counted by status, the person's active responsibilities (and let_go ones with includeLetGo=true), the ones still proposed, totals by status, and loose work under no responsibility. Each responsibility carries a rollup: health (on_track, at_risk, behind or not_measured, from the metric against its target), metric, statusSentence and workSummary signals from the projects, tasks and routines under it. Board users default to their own; agents default to the person their run works for, and must pass ownerUserId when the run works for no person. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Create or propose a responsibility
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Requires title, standard (the bar as a sentence) and metricName, plus the fields of the bar's template, metricKind: volume (metricTarget, optional metricDirection at_least or at_most and metricUnit), percentage (metricTarget 0-100, optional metricDirection; unit %), yes_no (no target: metricName is the statement that should be true) or range (metricLow and metricHigh, optional metricUnit). Without metricKind the bar is a percentage when metricUnit is %, otherwise a volume. metricCurrent (a number; true or false for yes_no), areaId and runByAgentId are optional. A board user creates an active responsibility for themselves. An agent acting for the person its run works for, when that person directed the run (their own chat or task, or their message woke it) and may manage the owner (their own, or anyone's for a company owner or admin), creates what that person could: a title alone is enough, it is active by default, and the change is saved as a version of the owner's Dashboard they can undo. Any other agent can only propose: it is saved with status proposed and source onboarding with the whole bar, and a board user confirms it. ownerUserId defaults to the person the run works for and must be a company member. Put why you propose it in evidence. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

get.summary: Read a responsibility with the work under it
get.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Returns the responsibility, its rollup, its area, the linked projects, tasks (direct, or through a linked project) and routines, the skills held by the agents working under it, and the artifacts its tasks produced. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

patch.summary: Update a responsibility or report its metric
patch.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. An agent acting for the person its run works for, when that person directed the run (their own chat or task, or their message woke it) and may manage the owner, may change every field as that person could, saved as a version of the owner's Dashboard they can undo. Other agents may edit only responsibilities that are still proposed and may set status only to proposed or dismissed; confirming (active) or letting go is that person's decision. On an active responsibility an agent may send only { metricCurrent } (a number; true or false for a yes_no bar) and only when it runs the responsibility (runByAgentId) or is assigned a task or routine under it. Changing metricKind clears the inputs the new template does not use, and the reading unless metricCurrent is sent too; the merged bar must follow its template (422 otherwise). Setting status active needs standard, metricName and the template's inputs (metricTarget for volume and percentage, metricLow and metricHigh for range; 422 otherwise). healthOverride null clears a manual status override. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

delete.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. A board user who manages the owner. An agent acting for such a person must also send confirmationId: an accepted request_confirmation card it posted, with target { type: custom, key: responsibility-delete:<id> }, accepted by someone who may manage the owner (403 responsibility_delete_confirmation_required otherwise). Its links go with it; the items stay. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

Files every item in one transaction; with moveFrom the items also leave that responsibility, or with all every other proposed or active responsibility of the same owner. A board user who manages the owner, or an agent acting for such a person (saved as an undoable Dashboard version). Returns { filed: [{ link, created }], unfiled: [link] }. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

get.summary: Read how automated a person's responsibilities are
get.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Same access and ownerUserId rules as listing responsibilities. Returns { ownerUserId, recentDays, responsibilities, areas, totals }. For each active responsibility: level (manual, some_automated, mostly_automated or automated), share (automations over automations plus manual tasks, 0-1, null with neither), automationCount, manualTaskCount, nothingFiled, automations (active routines with an agent, each with start: a schedule with its cadenceLabel and nextRunAt, a webhook with its webhookUrl and signingMode, a standing check with its lastResult, or on_request), stalledAutomations (paused, with no agent, or a standing check whose agent never wakes up on its own: no_wakeups), candidates (manual tasks most worth automating first, capped, each with reason, an instant hint { trigger: schedule | webhook | standing_check, words, cadence, why } or null, any pending agent offer, suggestedCadence, responsibleAgentId and any open automation conversation) and candidateTotal. Manual tasks are open or completed in the last recentDays days and exclude tasks a routine created, the onboarding task, bar and automation conversations and tasks already automated. areas and totals count each automation and task once. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Offer to repeat a finished task as a routine
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Only the agent assigned to the task. Use it once, at the end of work that plausibly recurs (after marking the task done, or just before finish_task; an offer made before the task is done stays hidden until it is) (a weekly report, a daily check, a monthly reconciliation), never for one-off work. Send title (what repeats), instructions (what each run does, written out in full without {{placeholders}}), cadence { frequency: daily | weekdays | weekly | monthly, dayOfWeek for weekly (monday..sunday), dayOfMonth 1-28 for monthly, time HH:MM in the person's local time } and an optional one-sentence message to the person. The person sees the offer in the task conversation and accepts or declines; you are not woken either way. Returns 409 when the task already has an offer or was cancelled, and 422 for a task a routine created or the onboarding task. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Accept a routine offer
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, with permission to assign tasks. Creates an active routine with the task's agent and project, scheduled at the offered cadence in timezone (defaults to the person's saved time zone, else UTC), files it under every responsibility the task is under, and returns { interaction, routine }. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Decline a routine offer
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only. Closes the offer; the task is not offered a routine again. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Turn a task into a routine
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, with permission to assign tasks. Send title, cadence { frequency: daily | weekdays | weekly | monthly, dayOfWeek for weekly, dayOfMonth 1-28 for monthly, time HH:MM }, assigneeAgentId and optional timezone (defaults to the person's saved time zone, else UTC). Creates an active routine with the task's project, scheduled at that cadence, records the task as its origin, files it under every responsibility the task is under, and settles the task's pending agent offer, if any, as accepted. The task itself is unchanged. Returns 201 { routine, cadenceLabel, timezone, responsibilityIds, acceptedOfferId }; 409 when a routine already repeats the task (routine_origin_exists) or the task was cancelled; 422 for a task a routine created, the onboarding task or a bar conversation. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

get.summary: Read where a responsibility's bar conversation stands
get.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only. Returns { responsibilityId, state (none, discussing, proposal_waiting or settled), defaultAgentId (null when no agent in the company can hold the conversation), conversation (the latest bar conversation task that was not cancelled), proposal (the pending proposal card, if any) }. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Start a conversation with an agent about a responsibility's bar
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the owner or a company admin, with permission to assign tasks. Opens a task assigned to agentId (default: the agent that runs the responsibility, else the top of the org chart) whose conversation ends in a proposed bar, and wakes the agent. Returns 201 with the conversation state, or 200 with the existing one when a conversation is open or a proposal is waiting. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Propose a bar in a responsibility's bar conversation
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Only the agent assigned to the bar conversation task. Send standard, metricKind (volume, percentage, yes_no or range; you choose), metricName and the template's inputs: metricTarget with optional metricDirection and metricUnit for volume, metricTarget 0-100 with optional metricDirection for percentage, no further inputs for yes_no, metricLow and metricHigh with optional metricUnit for range. Add metricCurrent (true or false for yes_no) only for a reading counted from real evidence, with currentEvidence saying how; add an optional one-sentence message. The responsibility stays as it is until a person accepts. A new proposal replaces the waiting one. 400 or 422 lists what is wrong with the bar; 409 means the conversation was cancelled or the responsibility closed. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Accept a proposed bar
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the responsibility's owner or a company admin. Applies the proposed bar (and its reading, if any) to the responsibility and settles the card in one transaction, and returns { interaction, responsibility }. Send keepMetrics (indexes into the proposal's supporting metrics) to apply only those and drop the rest; leave it out to apply them all. The bar's own metric is always applied, and the card's result lists droppedMetrics by title. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Say a proposed bar is not right
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the responsibility's owner or a company admin. Closes the card without changing the responsibility; the conversation continues and the agent can propose again. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

get.summary: Read where a person's Dashboard conversation stands
get.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Same access and ownerUserId rules as listing responsibilities. Returns { ownerUserId, empty (no active responsibility and none proposed), state (none, discussing, proposal_waiting or settled), defaultAgentId, conversation { issueId, identifier, mode create or edit, agentId, status }, proposal (the pending proposed changes, if any), latestChange (the newest version when it is applied changes or a restore from the last 24 hours, with previousVersionId for Undo) }. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

get.summary: List the saved versions of a person's Dashboard
get.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Same access and ownerUserId rules as listing responsibilities. Returns { ownerUserId, versions }, newest first and at most 30, each { id, cause (change_set, person or restore), summary, actorUserId, actorAgentId, previousVersionId, restoredFromVersionId, createdAt }. When the caller may change this dashboard, the dashboard as it is now is saved first if it changed by hand since the newest version. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Start a conversation with an agent about a person's Dashboard
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the person or a company admin. Send mode create (the agent interviews and researches the person, then drafts a first dashboard) or edit (the agent helps change it), optional ownerUserId (defaults to you) and agentId. Returns the open conversation when there is one (200), otherwise a new task assigned to the agent (201); a create conversation opens with the interview card. 422 when no agent can hold it. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Propose changes to a person's Dashboard in their dashboard conversation
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Only the agent assigned to the dashboard conversation task. Send { message (optional), changes }, an ordered list of: add_area { ref, name }, rename_area { areaId, name }, remove_area { areaId, reason }, add_responsibility { areaId or areaRef, sentence }, reword_responsibility { responsibilityId, sentence }, move_responsibility { responsibilityId, areaId or areaRef }, remove_responsibility { responsibilityId, reason }; each may carry a one-line reason, removals must. Nothing is applied: the person accepts the card, and may drop single changes first. A new proposal replaces the waiting one. 422 says what does not fit the dashboard; 409 when the conversation was cancelled. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Apply proposed Dashboard changes
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the person or a company admin. Optional keep lists the changes to apply by index; a kept change may not depend on a dropped one (422). Applies them in one transaction: removed responsibilities are let go and removed areas archived, never deleted; new responsibilities are active with only their sentence. Saves a version before and after. Returns { interaction, version }. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Say proposed Dashboard changes are not right
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the person or a company admin. Closes the card without changing anything; the conversation continues and the agent can propose again. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Restore a saved version of a person's Dashboard
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the person or a company admin. Puts back each area's and responsibility's name or sentence, area, order and status from the version; lets go of what the person owns now that it does not hold and archives an area left holding nothing of anyone's. Never deletes, and never touches bars, metrics, readings or what is filed under a responsibility. Saved as a new version, so it can be undone. Returns { version }. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

get.summary: Read a responsibility's metrics, ready to draw
get.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Same access as reading the responsibility. Returns { responsibilityId, source, chosenBy, metrics, historyLimit }. metrics holds up to three, the primary first: the bar's own metric (role primary, its template in kind, its derived health), then supporting ones. Each has key, id (a supporting metric's id, for readings), title, description (how it is measured), display (number, percent, line or bar), unit, target, direction, latest and readings (oldest first, at most historyLimit), stale and note. source is chosen (an agent proposed the set in the bar conversation and the person accepted, or the owner set it) or starter (computed now from the work under it: tasks finished per week, open tasks, the share on routines; never stored, and each has starter set). Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

put.summary: Set a responsibility's supporting metrics
put.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the owner or a company admin. Send metrics (at most two: title, description, display number | percent | line | bar, optional unit, target with direction at_least or at_most, readings [{ value, recordedAt }] and readingsEvidence) and optional primaryDisplay for the bar's own metric. Replaces the supporting metrics and returns the metric set. Agents propose a set in the bar conversation instead. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

patch.summary: Change how one responsibility metric is drawn
patch.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the owner or a company admin. metricId is a supporting metric's id, or primary for the bar's own metric. Send { display }: number, percent, line or bar, among the forms the metric's data allows (the bar's own follows its template: a range as number or line, a yes_no only as number; a supporting share as percent, line, bar or number; any other supporting metric as number, line or bar; 422 otherwise). Readings are unchanged. Returns the metric set. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

delete.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the owner or a company admin. Archives the supporting metric (its readings stay with it) and returns the metric set. The bar's own metric cannot be removed here. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Record a reading of a responsibility metric
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. metricId is a supporting metric's id, or primary for the bar's own metric. Send value (a number; true or false for a yes_no bar) and an optional note. An agent may record on an active responsibility it runs or has a task or routine under, and only what is true now: recordedAt is refused. The owner (or a company admin) may also send recordedAt (a past time, for history) or readingId (to correct one). A primary reading becomes the bar's reading (status follows it) unless it is older than the one shown, when it joins the history only. Returns 201 { reading }. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

get.summary: Read the recent agent runs on a responsibility's work
get.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Same access as reading the responsibility. Returns { responsibilityId, runs, limit }: the most recent heartbeat runs on the tasks under it (filed directly or through a linked project) and on the tasks its routines created, newest first, at most limit (default 8, at most 20). Each run has id, agentId, status (queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled or timed_out), createdAt, startedAt, finishedAt, issue { id, identifier, title } (the task it ran on) and routineId when the task came from one of its routines. Only runs on tasks the caller can read are listed. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

get.summary: Read where a task's automation conversation stands
get.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only. Returns { sourceIssueId, state (none, discussing, proposal_waiting or settled), defaultAgentId (the responsible agent, null when none can hold the conversation), conversation (the latest automation conversation task that was not cancelled), proposal (the pending proposal card, if any) }. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Start a conversation with an agent about automating a task
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, with permission to assign tasks. Opens a task assigned to agentId (default: the task's agent, else the agent that runs a responsibility it is under, starting with responsibilityId, else the organization's first assignable agent) whose description is the person's opening message with the instant hint and a link back, and wakes the agent. Returns 201 with the conversation state, or 200 with the existing one when a conversation is open or a proposal is waiting. 409 when the task is already automated or was cancelled; 422 for a task a routine created, the onboarding task or a bar or automation conversation. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Propose an automation in a task's automation conversation
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Only the agent assigned to the automation conversation task. Send title (what is done each time), instructions (in full, without {{placeholders}}), trigger and an optional one-sentence message. trigger is { kind: schedule, cadence: { frequency: daily | weekdays | weekly | monthly, dayOfWeek for weekly, dayOfMonth 1-28 for monthly, time HH:MM } }, { kind: webhook, caller: in words, what calls it and when } or { kind: standing_check, lookFor, whenFound } (only for an agent whose heartbeat wakes it; 422 automation_standing_check_no_heartbeat otherwise). No automation exists until a person accepts. A new proposal replaces the waiting one. 409 means the conversation was cancelled or the task is already automated. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Accept a proposed automation
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, with permission to assign tasks. Creates an active routine run by the conversation's agent, in the task's project, recording the task as its origin, with a schedule (in timezone, default the person's saved time zone, else UTC), a webhook trigger (bearer secret) or a standing check (a heartbeat trigger that never fires a run), files it under every responsibility the task is under, and returns { interaction, routine, webhook }. webhook is { url, secret, signingMode } for a webhook only and is shown once: the secret is not stored on the card. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Say a proposed automation is not right
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only. Closes the card without creating anything; the conversation continues and the agent can propose again. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Report what a standing check found
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Only the agent that runs the standing check (the routine's agent). Send outcome (acted, or nothing_needed when the check found no work), note (one plain sentence; required when you acted) and the optional issueId of a task you created or updated. Recorded as a completed routine run with source heartbeat. 409 when the check is paused or removed. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

get.summary: Read the agent-written status of a person's responsibilities
get.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Same access and ownerUserId rules as listing responsibilities. Returns { ownerUserId, freshDays, reports }: for each active responsibility, current (the newest report: status behind, at_risk, on_track or unknown, message, detail, agentId or userId of who wrote it, writtenAt and outOfDate when older than freshDays; null when none was written), reporterAgentId (the agent with the best total view of it: the agent doing the most under it, else the organization's top agent, else the first agent that can take work), reporterBasis (works_under, top_agent or first_agent) and updateRequested (the owner asked for an update and none has come since). Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

Requires enableResponsibilities. Same access as reading the responsibility. Returns { current, reporterAgentId, updateRequested, history }: current is the newest report with outOfDate, or null; history lists recent reports newest first. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Write a responsibility's status
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. An agent may write it when it is the responsibility's reporter or works under it (runs it, has a task or routine under it, or leads a linked project); a person may write it when they may edit the responsibility. Send status (behind, at_risk, on_track, or unknown when you cannot tell yet), message (one plain line saying why, at most 200 characters, no markdown) and optional detail (a few sentences). The author is the caller; it cannot be named in the body. The responsibility must be active (409 otherwise). Returns 201 with the same body as reading it. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.

post.summary: Ask the reporting agent for a status update
post.description: Requires enableResponsibilities. Board only, for the owner or a company admin, with permission to assign tasks. Opens a small task for the responsibility's reporter whose prompt carries the facts and the call, and wakes it; while one is open and unanswered, asking again changes nothing (200). Returns the same body as reading the status; 201 when a task was opened, 422 when no agent can take work. Experimental API; the corresponding instance feature must be enabled. Existing route authorization applies.
